build.recipe: Per ROM, from fixtures[].recipe: rgbasm -I fixtures/cgb-colour/ [-D name]... -o <work>/<rom>.o fixtures/cgb-colour/<source> && rgblink -o <work>/<rom> <work>/<rom>.o && rgbfix <rgbfix_flags> <work>/<rom>; tests/scripts/reproduce-cgb-colour.sh runs every row verbatim and compares the bytes
build.committed_bytes_toolchain: RGBDS v1.0.1 macOS release archive (digest above); the reproduction script rebuilds every ROM with the pinned tools and compares byte for byte

profile.name: CGB-CPU-E
profile.applicability: Original software fixture for the deterministic bootless CGB-CPU-E profile in CGB mode; not physical hardware evidence.

colour-hblank.gb.summary: BG tile 0 (all colour index 0) fills the screen with attribute 0; the guest rewrites BG palette 0 colour 0 once per line.
colour-hblank.gb.line_0: written during VBlank before the STAT mode-0 interrupt is armed
colour-hblank.gb.line_y_plus_1: written by the STAT mode-0 (HBlank) interrupt handler during the HBlank of line y; the handler writes line (y + 1) mod 144
colour-hblank.gb.regions: rows 0-143 of the 160x144 RGB555 frame, columns 0-159
colour-hblank.gb.expected: every row is uniform and equals hblank_value(row); the 144 row values are distinct and non-zero
colour-hblank.gb.structural_predicate: checked by cgb_colour_hblank_rows before the frame digest pin is compared

protocol.run: load on the CGB-CPU-E profile, run 10 frames, copy with gbb_copy_frame_rgb555

evidence_class: original software fixture plus synthetic oracle, not hardware evidence
scope_limits: No boot-ROM execution and no CGB boot palette table
CGB mode-3 timing is not claimed (D-09): the per-line write lands inside HBlank on this core's DMG mode-3 model, which is the only timing the fixture relies on
No physical CGB observation; the expectation is the guest's own value table
Not installed and not part of the install allowlist
